description:
Date format: yyyy, yyyy-MM, yyyy-MM-dd, yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm.
            If no datetime boundaries are set and limit is not set, the limit defaults to 100.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Start of period - incl. Either fixed value or dynamic - Now, StartOfDay, StartOfMonth or StartOfYear {+|-} iso period. Ex Now-PT12H

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Comma separated list of columns. Leave blank to include all columns

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Comma separated list of columns to sort by. Ex HourUTC, PriceArea. 
            If left blank the dataset is sorted by the unique key

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of records returned (default 100). 0 returns all values

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: DK (default) or UTC. For interpretation of fixed time values.
